findings.statement: A compact pigment-quenching-recovery relation predicts source QY_max on held plants with lower mean error than registered comparators

reliability.rationale: Held-plant MAE0.004833 improves design0.005051 only slightly; the reported paired interval crosses zero despite13/16 wins. Partial admission is appropriate. Claim-specific scope: A compact pigment-quenching-recovery relation predicts source QY_max on held plants with lower mean error than registered comparators

mechanism.rationale: NPQ, Rfd and QY_max share fluorescence measurements/calibration; pigment interaction is an assay descriptor, not independent physiological confirmation.

novelty.rationale: Primary-source analyses and established equation families are disclosed. This review does not establish exhaustive literature novelty or a new universal law.

significance.rationale: Useful as a transparent bounded research/evaluation case. RWC scaling and DAS meaning were unresolved and excluded; limited cultivars/chambers; manuscript citation incomplete; no universal superiority or field benefit.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact task, equation/state, group evidence, native semantics and provenance inspected; separate computational review is responsible for complete replay.

impact.rationale: No independent deployment, intervention, cost saving or clinical/industrial acceptance outcome was measured.

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Ambiguous RWC and conflicting day annotations are excluded; no hydration forecasting or identified photosynthetic law follows.
